The role claim view's report must stay out of Registry.Ping and WatchErr. Both feed the listener's self-health monitor, whose terminal failure surviving three recovery intervals self-terminates the listener; no restart completes a scan that keeps timing out, and the watcher's own rescan is what does. discoveredComplexity: kvwatch.Watcher.Complete is not one-way: a rewatch, a rescan and a recreated bucket's reset each clear it. WaitComplete therefore re-reads the state after every wake-up, and the wake-up channel is closed and replaced under the same lock that changes the state, so no waiter can miss one.

WaitComplete reads the watcher's terminal error before completeness, as RolesHeldBy does: Check records a recreated bucket's error without clearing complete, so the other order would let the gate answer nil while the view still refuses every read.

The lane's cost is dominated by two filters that cannot be narrowed: internal/dispatch/api's lock_level_test.go and internal/dispatch/store's search_text_test.go each walk every source file under packages/envoy, so envoy_go_race_api and envoy_go_race keep that wide root and select about two thirds of all heads.
